title: #86 - I Sentence You To Death
content:
#86 - I Sentence You To Death

Chapter 86 I sentence you to death

The wind was blowing and the rain was falling.

The Westerland troops, wearing robes of various colors, were attacking the stone outer wall of the village in the rain under the command of the Mountain.

Although they did not wear the scarlet cloaks of the Lannister family, but disguised as bandits, the lion-shaped half helmets had clearly revealed their identities.

Who else would wear such a helmet except the Lannister soldiers?

Arthur looked at the village called Shel, and suddenly a sense of fate rose in his heart.

Just like the sense of fate that Hodor had spent his whole life just to block that door.

More than a month ago, when he was on his way to King's Landing with Desmond, Patrick and others, he passed by here and fostered a tired red horse here.

At that time, he had just crossed over not long ago. Although he had a sense of justice in his heart, he was self-righteous and invincible with the system, but he had no awe. The gods and prophecies he casually said were even more laughable.

In the past few days of chasing the Mountain, everything he saw slowly made him understand the fear. He was not omnipotent.

There were many things he could not do, and he was too late to stop them.

For example, saving the villagers who were killed before.

Just the ones he encountered, there were more than a dozen villages that were killed and burned by the Mountain. Men, women, white-haired old people, and children, once living people turned into corpses in front of him and his companions.

Some of them may be villages that have strongly resisted. A large number of male heads were chopped off, impaled on long wooden sticks, and hung in conspicuous places at the entrance of the village and the main road, silently warning and intimidating passers-by.

What's more hateful is that some little girls were stripped naked, pregnant women had their stomachs cut open, and smiling white-haired old men were chopped until only a complete face was left.

They could have died more happily, but the Mountain and his men wanted to get some kind of satisfaction from killing and torturing people.

So they made them suffer in life and never kept their bodies intact after death.

Even the leader of the famous Bloody Troupe, Varg, said that compared to the extremely evil Mountain, all the members of the Bloody Troupe were kind people.

After his mood changed, Arthur returned to the village of Sheer. It might be a coincidence or it might be the push of fate. Anyway, he came.

"Fifteen years ago, they killed Princess Elia in this way!" Anger said with a trembling voice.

The normal decibel voice could not conceal the anger and murderous intent of this Dornishman.

The princess of the Martell family, whom they swore allegiance and protection, was killed by the Mountain first and then the baby was thrown to death.

That was the princess of their Dornish people!

Varg also sighed: "The Mountain is really evil. I don't know how the gods in the sky would allow such a demon to come into the world!"

[Mission: Save the Village of Sheer]

The blue light screen appeared, but this was no longer the main motivation for Arthur's actions.

Innocent people should not be responsible for the war, nor should they be dragged out of their homes and killed after being tortured.

They have never done anything evil to hurt others. They just simply live on their own land. However, they were besieged by the Mountain because of the dispute between the two nobles. This should not be the case.

Arthur cannot save the burned village in front, but he can help the village of Sheer.

"Come with me, let's go and play with them."

Arthur pulled out the New Moon on his waist, pointed the sword at the Mountain's army outside the village, and shouted with full energy.

[You will fight the enemy's 135 with a team of 47 people]

Although the enemy is more numerous than us, Arthur is not afraid.

Many things in the world cannot be done with 100% certainty.

If you don't try, how do you know if it works?

Besides, the situation in front of you is that you have to do it even if it doesn't work.

Watching hundreds of people in a village being killed and being indifferent and standing idly by, he is not worthy of being called "righteous" Arthur.

Forty-seven people rode their horses and charged, and under the cover of the rain, they killed the Mountain's army.

"Lord Clegane, the enemy is coming." The horse's hooves shook the ground, and soon, a Westerland soldier spotted the enemy.

Gregor Clegane, who was wearing leather armor, chain mail, and plate armor, looked back and caught a glimpse of Arthur, who was leading the group, and the soldiers behind him.

"Only these few people? Want to attack us?"

The Mountain sneered, and then ordered:

"Notepad, Sweet-mouthed Raff, you two take fifty people to continue attacking the village, and the rest of you follow me, let them know how powerful our Westerland soldiers are."

The Mountain asked his two trusted men to lead the team to attack the village, and he led his men to meet the enemy.

Soon, the eighty-three people on the Mountain's side and the forty-seven people on Arthur's side faced each other in the open space in front of the village.

The Dornish were spearmen, not used to fighting on horseback, so they dismounted just now and then ran to charge.

The backbone of the Blood Troupe included cavalry and infantry.

Most of the Mountain's side came running, and the enemy came in a hurry, and they had no time to get on the horse.

"Hey, isn't this the man called Arthur Bracken? Where's your giant hammer?" Polliver, another confidant of the Mountain, recognized Arthur Plate Armor and asked.

There was no way, the hammer was too scary, and a normal person would be finished after being hit by it.

"Do I need a giant hammer to deal with you?" Arthur's giant hammer was taken to the territory of the Red Mill and was not with him at the moment.

The weapons he had were the small hammer, the great sword New Moon, and the golden Guandao made by Tob.

These were enough.

"Let your people stop attacking the village, and then everyone surrenders and accepts my trial, otherwise I will use my hammer to hit your heads hard and intimately." Arthur shouted.

Mo Shan was very surprised, "We have done something wrong and we need to be judged by a little noble like you. Do you have the qualifications? Your territory is not much bigger than mine, right?"

While he was directing the troops to maintain their formation, he was bickering with Arthur.

Arthur dismounted, holding the sword in his left hand and the hammer in his right hand, and replied:

"Based on the burning, killing and looting you have done along the way, anyone with a sense of justice can judge you, let alone fifteen years ago when you killed Princess Ilia and an innocent child."

"I thought it was something." Seeing that Arthur really didn't have that giant hammer, Mo Shan felt relieved and his tone became brisk.

"These are Lord Tywin's orders. I just follow them faithfully."

Arthur also asked the backbone of the Blood Troupe and the Dornish people to maintain the basic formation, "Faithful execution, your tone is still very proud?"

"Yes." The Mountain replied, "Have you seen my family crest? I am Lord Tywin's dog. He gave me the castle and territory, and gave me glory and wealth. Naturally, I will do whatever he asks me to do. ”

"Besides, I made those villagers die happily. From this point of view, I am still a kind person."

"Glory and kindness, do you have anything to do with these two words?" Ange, a Dornishman, couldn't bear it when he heard this, and asked: "You are also a knight who has been anointed with holy oil. What have you accomplished in the three requirements of the knight?" a little?"

"I have done it all. Cut off their heads with a sword and prevent them from suffering. Is this kindness? Be loyal to your lord, loyal to the oath I swore to him, and use your own life to protect the Lannister family and me. The glory of the Clegane family, I have fulfilled the three requirements of the knight."

Seeing that his array was almost ready, Arthur felt it was time to start fighting.

"You can't escape punishment by sophistry." He said coldly, "Because of all the sins you have committed before, I sentence you to death."

After saying that, Arthur took the lead in charging.
